questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trees are bushes.

All bushes are herbs.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some herbs are bushes.

(II): All trees are herbs.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74383152f786a526ab164fb710f750630856ce943e18afca831c046f77e6a1a7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e5f3cda5f64f27e8f2225c5c943ed4f311dd92d76488cd00e4f29d56722034d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some herbs are bushes → Follow (As all bushes are herbs. As whole bushes comes in herbs, therefore it is true.)

II. All trees are herbs → Follow (As all trees are bushes and all bushes are herbs. As whole trees comes in bushes which whole comes in herbs, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: All 37 students in a class are standing in a row facing north. Nisha is 13th from the left end while Manasa is 15th from the right end. How many people stand between Nisha and Manasa?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Total students → 37

Nisha's rank from the left end → 13

Manasa's rank from the right end → 15

Total people stand between Nisha and Manasa → Total students - Nisha's rank from the left end - Manasa's rank from the right end

→ 37 - 13 - 15 = 9

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some roads are fans.

No fan is a car.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some roads are cars.

(II) Some fans are roads.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3ba7b202e6ced5938073bbcf17454670b514f97f6a7315b5d37ed80fb7588f0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40a576dc37962ce7f160489c9e5ffcdea0346591f17e0fadf0b530de3875d9ba.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some roads are cars → **Does not **follow (As some roads are fans and no fan is a car. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some fans are roads → Follow (As some roads are fans. As some part of roads is common with fans, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
